requirement.normalizedRequirement: PWOM shall include risk-based procedures covering voyage-limit avoidance, environmental forecasts, information limitations, required-equipment operation, and applicable low-temperature, topside-icing, and sea-ice functionality measures.
requirement.requiredInputs: PWOM and five required procedure coverage indicators
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: The Manual shall include risk-based procedures for the following: voyage planning to avoid ice and/or temperatures that exceed the ship's design capabilities or limitations; arrangements for receiving forecasts of the environmental conditions; means of addressing any limitations of the hydrographic, meteorological and navigational information available; operation of equipment required under other chapters of this Code; and implementation of special measures to maintain equipment and system functionality under low temperatures, topside icing and the presence of sea ice, as applicable.
